description: Scenario tests for reels-script. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-reel
evals.input: Write an Instagram Reel about why our most-requested feature flopped.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
hooks within the first ~3 seconds (verbal + on-screen text + visual), no slow intro
writes muted-first: the on-screen text carries the story without audio
structures for watch-through and sends (fast pacing, open loop, a loop/rewatch trigger, a concrete who-forwards-this answer)
outputs a production doc (shot - on-screen text - spoken - audio - timing) plus a cover-frame brief
places IG keywords in the first spoken seconds, on-screen text, and caption (via instagram-seo) and hands the caption to caption-writer
routes publishing to instagram-reels-publishing and scheduling to scheduling-and-queue

evals.name: three-second-sound-off-hook
evals.input: Give me the opening for a Reel about saving money on SaaS.
expect: the hook lands in the first ~3 seconds
combines a verbal hook with a bold on-screen text hook that works on mute
does NOT open with a logo, intro, or 'hey guys welcome back'

evals.name: tiktok-reupload-pushback
evals.input: Just repost my TikToks to Reels, they already perform well there.
expect: pushes back that watermarked reposts are throttled by the originality and watermark gates
recommends a clean, re-cut native version (and routes adaptation to cross-platform-repurposing)
does not endorse posting the watermarked file

evals.name: watch-through-and-sends
evals.input: How do I get more reach on this Reel?
expect: explains watch time (the first ~3 seconds) and sends-per-reach (DM shares) as the dominant discovery signals
notes sends are weighted roughly 3-5x more than likes for reaching new people
designs a loop or rewatch trigger and answers who would forward the Reel and why
removes retention killers (slow intro, dead air, sound-on-only hook)

evals.name: trending-audio-native-limit
evals.input: Pick a trending song and attach it to the Reel when you schedule it.
expect: explains Instagram's licensed audio library is native-only: the human adds the track in-app
does NOT claim WoopSocial can attach trending audio
still names an audio direction in the script (and routes live trend research to trend-jacking)
keeps the script working on mute regardless of the audio choice

evals.name: reels-seo-keywords
evals.input: I want this Reel to show up when people search our topic on Instagram.
expect: treats Instagram search as keyword-based (not hashtag-based)
places the target keyword in the first ~3 spoken seconds, the on-screen text, and the caption's first sentence
routes keyword research and the search-first caption to instagram-seo, with 3-5 topic hashtags rather than dozens

evals.name: trial-reel-for-unproven-hook
evals.input: I'm not sure this hook will land with a cold audience. Should I just post it?
expect: recommends a Trial Reel to test with non-followers first at no cost to follower-facing stats
does not guarantee virality or fabricate expected numbers

evals.name: veo-pack-honest-caveat
evals.input: Generate this Reel with AI video instead of filming it.
expect: provides a Veo prompt pack mapping beats to ~8-second 9:16 prompts with crop-safe, centered framing
flags that filming faces usually builds more trust, and recommends AI mainly for faceless niches, b-roll, or unfilmable shots
notes AI-disclosure on Instagram is native/manual per Meta's rules (not auto-disclosed like TikTok) and points to tools/integrations/veo.md

evals.name: reads-voice-thin-input
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and 'hey guys'.
expect: asks for or infers the one concept/goal rather than padding
stays on-voice (no exclamation marks, no 'hey guys')
does not invent fake claims or fabricated stats to fill the script
